title: Use Seedance 2.5 1080p in CapCut to generate closer-to-final-quality outputs…
content:
Use Seedance 2.5 1080p in CapCut to generate closer-to-final-quality outputs before finishing edits  
Turn one product image into multiple angles, environments, and shot sizes using Seedance 2.5 in CapCut for product content  
Use AI Extend in CapCut to extend a Seedance-generated scene  
Use AI Edit in CapCut to fix awkward details in Seedance-generated footage  
Use Edit Pilot in CapCut to manage and apply a large batch of edits after generating with Seedance
